purpose: Current-tree reconciliation of semantic lookup infrastructure shared by pnpm ast, Verify, and Codemod Kit.
alreadyShared: tooling/src/_shared/compiler-programs.ts owns authored tsconfig discovery, native roots, references, options, and filename overlays
tooling/src/_shared/ts-workspace.ts owns lazy native-world ts-morph projects, physical source identity, and cross-world reference union
tooling/src/_shared/reference-fact*.ts owns binding, declaration, module-export, alias, write, cycle, and refusal semantics

confirmedGaps.evidence: AST retains three module-resolution routes: relative extension candidates, checker-derived dynamic targets, and an uncached raw TypeScript resolver with a different extension set.
confirmedGaps.repair: Add world-aware moduleTargets to SemanticWorkspace using each native program's options and usage-location mode; preserve program identity on disagreement and deduplicate identical physical targets.

confirmedGaps.evidence: Checker-dependent consumers still need an explicit projection from a physical syntax node into every containing native program.
confirmedGaps.repair: Add nodeViews keyed by canonical path and physical span; never pass ts-morph nodes or symbols across Projects.

confirmedGaps.evidence: tooling/src/codemod/lib/symbols.ts selects getExportedDeclarations()[0], so merges and overload sets can be silently collapsed.
confirmedGaps.repair: Use the shared complete exported-declaration fact; identity-changing edits must accept one proven home or refuse a genuine merge/conflict.

confirmedGaps.evidence: tooling/src/ast/ops/symbols.ts renders only the first exported declaration.
confirmedGaps.repair: Render the complete declaration set or explicitly label the declaration count and collapse rule.

confirmedGaps.evidence: Verify opens pass-scoped reference-fact caches; AST consumers do not, while the shared comment claims both dispatchers do.
confirmedGaps.repair: If AST/Codemod adoption grows, use an explicit per-invocation resolver session; do not introduce a process-global cache.

keepToolSpecific: Verify populations, policy authority, findings, and receipts
